style.sofa: a large cream bouclé sofa with warm beige textiles and a soft linen throw
style.room: A premium warm Scandinavian living room: a soft upholstered lounge armchair in a warm cream bouclé, a minimalist oak sideboard, a ceramic mushroom lamp, a large indoor plant, a neutral abstract artwork in a thin oak frame, a few carefully selected ceramic objects. Colour palette: warm ivory, cream, sand, beige, pale oak and subtle earthy accents. Lighting: late-afternoon natural sunlight through large windows with sheer linen curtains, soft realistic shadows across the floor and the mat. High-end Scandinavian editorial interior photography, sophisticated yet cozy, realistic material textures, natural colour grading, 35mm lens, high detail.
